subject.title: Feature: add a repo-native live updater maintainer skill

question: Should this maintainer-owned live updater become a dedicated bundled skill as the canonical thin orchestration layer?
rationale: The capability is concrete and missing, but it adds a privileged bundled skill under VISION.md guardrails; maintainers must confirm the permanent ownership seam before implementation.

options.title: Approve thin controller
options.body: Add the skill and helper with only live-mirror invariants and orchestration, reusing existing testing, release-CI, autoreview, PR, stamp, Gateway, and Mac owners.

options.title: Keep prompt composition
options.body: Retain the current operator prompt and strengthen existing skills without adding a new bundled skill surface.

options.title: Consolidate into existing skills
options.body: Distribute the missing checks among current testing, release-CI, and platform skills, accepting a less centralized recurring workflow.

recommendation.title: Approve thin controller
recommendation.body: Add the skill and helper with only live-mirror invariants and orchestration, reusing existing testing, release-CI, autoreview, PR, stamp, Gateway, and Mac owners.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the requested operational contract and introduced most of the adjacent current-main primitives.
